body:
## Issue

The application status stepper shows `Submitted → Reviewing → Shortlisted → Viewed → Approved`, but the bare label **"Viewed"** is ambiguous. It reads as "the application was opened/seen" — or even "the vacancy was viewed" — when it actually means **"the viewing with the applicant was carried out"** (RC2.2 amendment A5: *"the application reflects where it really is once the landlord marks the viewing as carried out"*).

This matters because **the transition INTO `viewed` is the reference-check trigger** — it mints the queued reference calls. A landlord who doesn't realise "Viewed" means "I did the property viewing" either:
- never marks it (checks never auto-start), or
- marks it thinking it's a passive "I've seen this application" (checks fire before they're ready).

## Context

- `supabase/migrations/20260808120000_add_viewed_application_status.sql` — enum value added AFTER `shortlisted`
- `client/src/components/status_stepper.gleam` — stepper order + labels
- The reference-check trigger moved from Shortlist to Viewed so checks start at the viewing moment, not at pursuit (A5)
- Unrelated to the vacancy ad-view counter (`vacancy.viewed_at`, `20260404070000_add_vacancy_view.sql`)

## Suggested fix (copy/UX decision — implementation follows)

1. Helper line under the Viewed step, e.g. **"Mark when you've carried out the viewing — reference checks start here."**
2. Make the stepper's next action obvious after Shortlist (the Viewed step should present itself as the next button to click, not a passive state).
3. Consider a label that reads as an action rather than a state ("Viewing done" / "Viewing carried out") — copy decision, brand-voice pass required (`_bmad-output/story-2026-04-03.md`).

## Acceptance

- [ ] A landlord seeing the stepper for the first time understands when to click Viewed and what it starts
- [ ] Reference-check trigger stays on the Viewed transition (no logic change intended — this is clarity, not semantics)
- [ ] Copy follows brand voice; no em dashes (per the no-em-dash ruling)
title: Stepper: 'Viewed' status label is ambiguous — reads as 'application opened' not 'viewing carried out' (the refcheck trigger moment)
